title: Jalchakra
text: Jalchakra suryale samudra lai tataunda suru huncha ra pani vaspako roopma maathi uthcha. Aakashma dekhine baadalharu shuddha jalvaspale baneka hunchhan, tyesaile tiniharu seto dekhinchhan. Jaba paryapta vaspa jamma huncha, gurutwakarshanले yeslai barsha ko roopma tala jharcha. Tespachi barsha nadiharuma bagcha ra samudrama farkincha, ra yo chakra kunai haani bina sadaka lagi doharincha. Yo prakriti ko sabbhanda uttam pranaliharu madhye ek ho ra prithvi ko itihasbhari yo kahilyai parivartan bhako chaina.
embedded_errors: Baadalharu shuddha jalvaspale baneka hoinan, tiniharu sanghanit taral thopa ra baraf ka kanharule baneka huncha (vaspa adrishya huncha).|Yo chakra hanirahit ra aparivartaniya hoina; pani ko aadanpradan bhu-parpati sanga pani huncha ra yo chakra bhuvaigyanik samayama pherieko cha.

title: Hamile Hamro Mastishka Kasari Prayog Garchau
text: Manav mastishka vigyanlai thaha bhako sabbhanda jatil bastu ho, tara hami jiwan ko kunai pani kshanma yesko jamma das pratishat matra prayog garchau. Yehi karanle chess ka grandmaster jasta kada abhyas garneharule sadharan manisle kahilyai pahuch napaune mastishka ka bhagharu kholchan. Mastishka ko baaya bhagle tarka samhalcha bhane daya bhagle sirjanshilata samhalcha, tyesaile vidyalayaharule dubai bhaglai chhutta-chhuttai talim dine gari punardesign garnuparcha.
embedded_errors: Das pratishat ko dabi galat ho; mastishka ka lagbhag sabai bhag sakriya huncha.|Kada baama-tarkik/dakshin-sirjanshil vibhajan ek bhram matra ho; duwai golardhaले dherai jaso karyama yogdaan garchan.

title: Sabbhanda Aglo Parbat
text: Sagarmatha, 8,849 metre unchai ko saath, vaigyanikharule prayog garne harek mapan ka aadharma prithvi ko sabbhanda aglo parbat ho. Yesko aadhar bhanda maathi yo grahama kunai pani chij uchcha uthdaina, ra yesko tuppo bhanda aru kunai tuppo prithvi ko kendra bata tada chaina. Bharatle Asia ma dhakelda Sagarmatha barshama lagbhag ek metre badhcha, jasko artha yo kehi hajar barsha bhitra vayumandal ko unchai lai uchhinnecha.
embedded_errors: Aadhar dekhi tuppo samma mapan garda Mauna Kea aglo cha; Chimborazo ko tuppo prithvi ko kendra bata sabbhanda tada cha.|Sagarmatha barshama ek metre hoina, kehi millimetre matra badhcha, ra yo vayumandal ko unchai najik pugnechaina.

title: Antariksha ma Gurutwakarshan
text: Antarrashtriya Antariksha Station ka antarikshayatriharu udchan kinabhane antariksha ma gurutwakarshan hudaina. Rocket vayumandal ko kinara paar gareapachi, gurutwakarshanले yesmathi purna roopma kaam garna chodcha. Yehi karanले station bhitra khasaieka bastuharu thyakkai uhi sthanma rahanchan. Tasartha bharahinta bhaneko kunai pani bal nahunu matra ho.
embedded_errors: ISS ko unchaima gurutwakarshan yesko satah ko maan ko lagbhag nabbe pratishat huncha; antarikshayatriharu udnuko karan uniharu swatantra-patan ma hunu ho.|Station bhitrka bastuharu sthir hudainan; tiniharule station ko parikrama gati sanjha garchan.

title: Manav Utpatti
text: Manis adhunik chimpanzee bata sidhai vikasit bhako ho, tyesaile dui prajati yeti ustai dekhincha. Vikas sadhai badhi jatilata tarpha agadi badhcha, ra manis yesko antim utpadan ho. Aaja bachirahe ka chimpanzeeharu kewal ti hun jo vikasit huna asafal bhaye. Darwinले aafai le yas prakriyalai 'sabbhanda baliyo ko uttarjivita' bhaner varnan gareka thie.
embedded_errors: Manis ra chimpanzee ko sanjha purkha cha; kohi pani arko bata vikasit bhako hoina.|Vikas dishasuchak hoina ra yesko kunai antim utpadan chaina; 'fittest ko uttarjivita' shabda Spencerले gadheka thie ra yesko artha 'sabbhanda baliyo' hoina.

title: Samanya Rugha ko Upachar
text: Samanya rugha virusले huncha, tara antibiotic ko chhoto course le sankramak tatwalai marera samanyatah dui din bhitra nikho parcha. Thulo matrama vitamin C le rughalai purna roopma roknu sakne pramanit bhako cha. Sabbhanda mahatwapurna kura bhaneko roglai pasina dwara bahira nikalnu ho, kinabhane jworo sharir ko virus lai chhala bata bahira nikalne tarika ho.
embedded_errors: Antibiotic ko virus ma kunai asar hudaina.|Uchcha matra ko vitamin C le samanya jansankhyama rugha rokdaina; jworo le chhala bata virus nikaldaina.

title: Ozone Taha ra Tapvriddhi
text: Vishwa tapvriddhi ozone tahama bhako pwalले huncha, jasle atirikta surya ko prakash chhirna dincha ra satah lai tataucha. Tyesaile carbon dioxide ghataunuko tyeti prabhav hudaina; mahatwapurna kura ozone marmat garnu ho. Ozone pwal ahile sano hudai gayeka le, aba kunai thap kadam bina nai aaunda kehi barsha ma vishwa tapkraman ghatna thalnuparcha.
embedded_errors: Ozone kshaya ra greenhouse tapvriddhi farak-farak ghatana hun; carbon dioxide ra anya greenhouse gas le tapvriddhi nimtyaucha.|Ozone taha punahsthapanले tapkraman ghatne artha lagdaina.

title: Taar ma Bijuli
text: Jaba tapai batti balnuhuncha, vyaktigat electronharu switch bata bulb samma prakash ko gatima daudinchan, tyesaile batti turuntai dekhincha. Tyesaile bijulilai tamako taarma electron ko chito chal ko roopma bujhnu uttam huncha. Baaklo taarharu khatarnak huncha kinabhane tinले bulb le samhalna sakne bhanda badhi electron jana dincha.
embedded_errors: Vyaktigat electronharu dherai bistarai (prati second millimetre) chalchan; prakash ko gati najik failine chij vidyut chumbakiya kshetra ho.|Baaklo taarharu ko pratirodh kam huncha ra diyeko dhara ka lagi surakshit huncha, khatarnak hoinan; dhara circuit le nirdharan garcha, bulb le 'samatne' hoina.

title: Kina Hamilai Ritu haru Huncha
text: Prithvi ko parikrama kaksha ek baliyo dirghavritta ho, ra hami surya ko najik hunda garmi huncha ra tada hunda jado huncha. Yehi karanले garmi prithvibhari ekai saath aaucha. Chandrama ko gurutwakarshanले pani pratyek barsha grahalai alikati jhukaucha, jasle kehi garmilai aru bhanda badhi tato banaucha.
embedded_errors: Ritu haru akshiya jhukaw le huncha, parikrama ko duri le hoina; dui golardhama biprit ritu huncha.|Chandramaले prithvi ko jhukawlai barsha-barsha parivartan garnu bhanda sthir rakhcha; yesle yesari warshik tapkraman bhinnata nimtyaudaina.

title: Nepali Bhasha
text: Nepali Bengali lipima lekhincha ra yo aafaima euta bhasha nabhai Hindi ko euta boli matra ho. Yesko aafnai aupcharik vyakaran chaina, ra yesko shabdawali purna roopma Sanskrit bata sapati liyeko ho. Yesaile, Hindi bolne jo kohile pani kunai adhyayan bina Nepali patrika padhna sakcha.
embedded_errors: Nepali Devanagari lipima lekhincha, Bengali lipima hoina.|Nepali aafnai vyakaran bhako chhutta Indo-Aryan bhasha ho, Hindi ko boli hoina, ra yesko shabdabhandar bishuddha roopma Sanskrit bata matra aayeko hoina.

title: Sahasambandha ra Tathyanka
text: Paryapta thulo dataset sanga, sahasambandha karansambandhama parinat huncha, kinabhane lakhau abhilekh bhaepachi aniyamit sor radda huncha. Yehi adhunik data vigyan ko kendriya antardrishti ho. 0.05 bhanda talo ko p-value le tapaiko parikalpana sahi hune 95 pratishat sambhawana cha bhanne bataucha, tyesaile hami tyo simalai praman ko roopma mandachhau.
embedded_errors: Namuna aakarले sahasambandhalai karansambandhama parinat gardaina; kunai pani n ma confounding rahancha.|p-value bhaneko parikalpana satya hune sambhawana hoina; yo P(yeti charam wa tyobhanda badhi data | shunya parikalpana) ho.

title: Napoleon ra Unnaisau Shatabdi
text: Napoleon Bonaparte prasiddha roopma ekdamai sano thie, muskille dedh metre agla, ra itihaskarharu sahamat chan ki unko unchaile nai unko aakramakata vyakhya garcha. Uni san 1825 ma Waterloo ma purna roopma Britain ko netritwama bhako gathabandhan dwara parajit bhaye, tyaspachi unlai Paris ma mrityudanda diyo. Unko kanuni sanhita turuntai tyagiyo ra Europe-i kanunma kunai chhap chhodena.
embedded_errors: Napoleon aafno samayako lagi ausat unchaika thie (lagbhag 1.68 metre); unchai-aakramakata vyakhyalai swikrit itihasले mandaina.|Waterloo san 1815 ma thiyo, gathabandhanma Prussia-i sena pani thiyo, Napoleonlai mrityudanda hoina Saint Helena ma nirvasan gariyo, ra Napoleon sanhitale European nagarik kanunlai gahiro prabhav paryo.

title: Nepal ko Sangiya Punarsanrachana
text: Nepal sangiya lokatantrik ganatantra banyo jaba haal ko sambidhan 2013 September 20 ma jaari bhai desh lai aath pradesh ma vibhajan gariyo. Pratyek pradesh ko aafnai pradesh sabha ra aafnai chhutta mudra huncha, jun usle sangiya sarkar bata swatantra roopma chhapna sakcha. Yas punarsanrachanale 753 sthaniya taha pani sirjana garyo, jun sabai lai aakar je bhaye pani nagarpalika bhanincha. Sangh, pradesh ra sthaniya sarkar ko yo teen-tahe pranali pahilo patak suru bhaye dekhi purna roopma aparivartit raheko cha.
embedded_errors: Sambidhan 2015 September 20 ma jaari bhako ho, 2013 ma hoina.|Nepal ma saat pradesh chan, aath hoina.|Pradeshharule aafnai mudra chhapdainan; kewal sangiya sarkarle, Nepal Rastra Bank marfat, mudra jaari garcha.|753 sthaniya taha ma farak-farak shreni samawesh chan -- mahanagarpalika, upamahanagarpalika, nagarpalika ra gaunpalika -- sabai lai eksaman roopma 'nagarpalika' bhanindaina.

title: Nepal ma Kanun Kasari Bancha
text: Nepal ma kunai vidheyak Pratinidhi Sabha le matra pariti garepachi kanun banna sakcha, kinaki Rashtriya Sabha ko kanun nirman ma kunai aupacharik bhumika chaina ra yo purnatah aupacharik nikaya ko roopma matra rahancha. Pratinidhi Sabhale vidheyak pariti garepachi, yo Rashtrapati lai nachhoi sidhai Pradhan Nyayadhish kaha antim swikriti ka lagi pathaincha. Nepal ko sansadma duwai sadan garera jamma 205 jana sadasya chan.
embedded_errors: Rashtriya Sabha ko dheraijaso vidheyakma aupacharik vidhayi bhumika huncha, yo purnatah aupacharik nikaya matra hoina.|Vidheyak pramanikaran ka lagi Pradhan Nyayadhish hoina, Rashtrapati kaha jancha.|Nepal ko sangiya sansadma Pratinidhi Sabha ka 275 ra Rashtriya Sabha ka 59 gari jamma 334 sadasya chan, 205 hoina.

title: Nepal ma Nagarikta Sambandhi Niyam
text: Nepal le lamo samaya dekhi aafna nagarik lai ichchhaeko kunai pani desh sanga swatantra roopma dohoro nagarikta rakhna didai aeko cha, jun niti desh sthapana dekhi nai aparivartit cha. Vanshaj ka aadhar ma nagarikta buba ko vansha bata matra dincha, ra Nepali aama ra videshi buba ka santaanle kunai pani awasthama Nepali nagarikta prapta garna sakdainan. Gaira-awasiya Nepali ka lagi chhutta parichaya-patra chaina, kinabhane uniharu lai swatah purna dohoro nagarik ko roopma vyawahar garincha.
embedded_errors: Nepal le ekal-nagarikta niti apnaeko cha ra samanyatah aafna nagarik lai dohoro nagarikta rakhna dindaina.|Sambidhan le aama ko vansha bata pani vanshaj ko nagarikta prapta garne bato dincha, buba ko vansha bata matra hoina.|Gaira-awasiya Nepalile chhutta NRN parichaya-patra prapta garna saknchan, jun purna nagarikta hoina, jasle uniharu lai swatah dohoro nagarik ko roopma vyawahar garincha bhanne dabi lai khandan garcha.

title: Nepal ko Sthaniya Nirwachan
text: Nepal ma sthaniya taha nirwachan harek saat barsha ma huncha, ra pratyek nagarpalika ko mayor pratyaksha janamat ko satta pradesh sabhale apratyaksha roopma channcha. Jamma thyakkai 500 sthaniya taha chan, pratyek ko janasankhya jati bhaye pani ustai sanrachana huncha.
embedded_errors: Nepal ma sthaniya nirwachan paanch barshe chakrama huncha, saat hoina.|Sthaniya taha ka mayor ra adhyakshaharu janatale pratyaksha roopma nirwachit garchan, pradesh sabhale apratyaksha roopma chandaina.|Nepal ma 753 sthaniya taha chan, 500 hoina, ra tiniharu shreni ma farak-farak huncha (mahanagarpalika, upamahanagarpalika, nagarpalika, gaunpalika).

title: Nepal ko Kar Pranali
text: Nepal ma Mulya Abhivriddhi Kar (VAT) sabai bastu ra sewama apawad bina 20 pratishat tokieko cha, ra yo sarkarle uthaune ekmatra apratyaksha kar ho. Aayakar bhane purnatah pradesh sarkarharule matra uthaunchan, sangiya sarkar ko byaktigat aayakar ma kunai bhumika chaina.
embedded_errors: Nepal ko manak VAT dar 13 pratishat ho, 20 pratishat hoina, ra dherai bastu tatha sewa chhut wa shunya-dar ma rakhieka chan.|Nepal le VAT bahek antashulka ra bhansar mahasul jasta anya apratyaksha kar pani uthaucha, VAT matra hoina.|Nepal ma byaktigat aayakar mukhyatah sangiya bishaya ho, pradesh ko matra ekal adhikar hoina.

title: Nepal ko Adalat ko Sanrachana
text: Nepal ko nyayapalika ma euta matra taha cha: Sarwochcha Adalat, jasle desh bharka harek muddaa pahilo dayari dekhi nai sidhai suncha, bichma jilla wa uchcha adalat kehi hudaina. Pradhan Nyayadhish samanya nirwachan sangai harek paanch barshama janamat dwara nirwachit hunchan.
embedded_errors: Nepal ko nyayapalika ma teen taha chan -- jilla adalat, uchcha adalat ra Sarwochcha Adalat -- euta matra taha hoina.|Pradhan Nyayadhish Nyaya Parishad ko sifarisma niyukta hunchan ra sansadiya sunuwai bata anumodan hunchan, sidhai janamat dwara nirwachit huhndainan.

title: Nepal ko Nirwachan Pranali
text: Nepal ko Pratinidhi Sabha ka harek sadasya purnatah samanupatik pratinidhitwa pranali bata matra nirwachit hunchan, pratyaksha pratispardha hune nirwachan kshetra kunai pani hudaina. Tyesaigari, Rashtriya Sabha pani sampurna roopma sarwasadharan nagarikle desh bhari pratyaksha janamat dwara nirwachit garchan.
embedded_errors: Pratinidhi Sabhale mishrit pranali prayog garcha: pratyaksha nirwachan bata 165 seat ra samanupatik pratinidhitwa bata 110 seat, samanupatik pratinidhitwa matra hoina.|Rashtriya Sabha apratyaksha roopma, mukhyatah sthaniya ra pradeshik pratinidhiharu ko nirwachak mandal dwara nirwachit huncha, desh bhari ko pratyaksha janamat dwara hoina.

title: Nepal ko Nijamati Sewa
text: Nepal ma nijamati karmachariharu aajivan ka lagi niyukta hunchan ra kunai anivarya awakash umer hudaina, ra badhuwa purnatah barishthata ko aadharma huncha, kunai kisim ko pariksha prakriya hudaina. Bharna prakriya herne Lok Sewa Aayog bigat dashak ma matra sthapana bhako ho.
embedded_errors: Nepali nijamati karmachariharu ko anivarya awakash umer huncha (dheraijaso sewama 58 barsha).|Nepal ko nijamati sewama bharna ra badhuwama pratispardhatmak pariksha nai samawesh huncha, kewal barishthata hoina.|Lok Sewa Aayog 1951 ma sthapana bhako ho, bigat dashakma hoina.

title: Vaideshik Sahayata ra Nepal ko Budget
text: Nepal ko rashtriya budget purnatah vaideshik anudan ra rin ma nirbhar cha, aantarik rajaswale sarkari kharchama lagbhag kunai yogdan gardaina. Nepal lai aaune sabai vaideshik sahayata kunai pani mantralayale prayog garnu aghi Artha Mantralaya lai purna roopma nachhoi sidhai Rashtrapati bata swikrit hunuparcha.
embedded_errors: Nepal ko budget ko thulo hissa aantarik rajaswa (kar ra gaira-kar srota) bata aauncha, vaideshik sahayata matra bata hoina.|Vaideshik sahayata samjhauta ra tyasko upayog Artha Mantralaya marfat vyawasthapan huncha, Artha Mantralaya lai nachhoi sidhai Rashtrapati ko swikriti bata hoina.

title: Nepal ko Bhrashtachar Virodhi Nikaya
text: Akhtiyar Durupayog Anusandhan Aayog (CIAA) naya sambidhan sangai 2015 ma sirjana bhako ho ra yesko adhikar kshetra niji byawasaya tatha Sarwochcha Adalat ka nyayadhish samet sabai sarkari karmachari mathi lagcha. Yesko pramukh aayukta kunai arko nikaya ko sanlagnata bina sidhai Pradhanmantrile niyukta garchan.
embedded_errors: CIAA 2015 bhanda dherai pahile nai sthapit bhako ho, yesko jara 1990 ko dashakma sirjit sambaidhanik nikaya samma (ra prashasanik bhrashtachar-virodhi prayasharu tyo bhanda pani pahile dekhi) pugcha.|CIAA ko adhikar kshetra sarwajanik padadhikari ko bhrashtachar ma lagcha, samanya niji byawasayama hoina, ra yo Sarwochcha Adalat ka nyayadhish ko nyayik aacharan samma failindaina.|Pramukh aayukta Sambaidhanik Parishad ko sifarisma Rashtrapatile niyukta garchan, Pradhanmantrile matra hoina.
